tasks.summary: Switched Grafana to internal ClickHouse native/9000 with provisioning version 2 to avoid HTTP server-hello failures. Static checks cover protocol, port and five-second driver deadline headroom. Read-only limits retained; no services launched. Live host verification remains required.

Handle non-JSON HTTP responses without engine parser errors, report transport/status/acknowledgement failures and preserve retry classification. Standalone tests pass for malformed responses, error statuses, invalid acknowledgements and connection failures. No backend services started.

Provisioned explicit 30-second Grafana query and connection max_execution_time settings within the ClickHouse reader's 60-second ceiling. Static validation compares settings with server constraints. No services launched; deployed verification requires pulling backend changes and restarting Grafana.

Made backend submodule self-contained with local Docker context/COPY paths, bundled event contract, local schema resolution, restricted build context and independent checkout documentation. Restored missing ClickHouse account/Grafana password fixes. Seven mocked ingestion tests and artifact checks pass from an isolated backend-only copy; Docker CLI unavailable, image build remains host validation. No services started or commits made.

Removed remaining Talo runtime/UI/export/test integration; validation uses isolated Null telemetry. Provisioned ClickHouse ingestion and Grafana accounts with environment passwords, explicit grants, bounded reader timeout changes and safe Grafana password substitution. Gameplay smoke, standalone addon, mocked ingestion and backend static checks pass; live backend authentication remains operator validation. No backend services started.

Fixed maximum-size events stalling minimum-size telemetry batches by counting commas only between events. Standalone regression reproduces the old empty-batch stall and verifies exact byte limits, FIFO acknowledgement progress and complete queue drainage after the fix.

Implemented combat victory/AI fixes, real-scene AutoWalker Watch/headless/policies/replay/run progression, standalone schema-aware telemetry addon, Talo event migration, and ingestion/ClickHouse/Grafana deployment source package. Local runtime and mocked/static backend evidence plus explicit shutdown/integration limits are recorded in ai/docs/implementation-checklist.md. No backend services started or deployed.

Migrated first-party UI to the shared Rift theme and named variations, authored fixed visuals as native scenes, repaired reward/shop layout and activation, and split run/battle HUDs, tutorials, pause, legend and sandbox panel into owned components. Removed private child injection and UI group discovery. Native scene save/reload ownership and interaction checks pass; see ai/docs/continuous-improvement.md for validation and shutdown limits.

Fixed shaders ignoring CanvasItem fade alpha, inverted outcome vignette, fullscreen scaling, frozen intros over paused tutorials, arbitrary victory timing and overlapping view lifetimes. Removed competing music-volume swells. Rendered zero/half/full alpha samples and transition completion checks pass; native texture shutdown diagnostics remain.

Fixed null-card draws from exhausted decks and animation-dependent discard state. Added runtime regression checks for phase ordering, interrupted/completed discard animations, immediate reshuffle, overdraw, zero-card draws, and standalone cleanup. See ai/docs/continuous-improvement.md for validation and limits.

Fixed two DataEditor enum lookups that used the inherited node name instead of the loop key. Added runtime scene-startup coverage for all enum dropdowns and resource-list initialization. Zero failed smoke assertions and no script errors; runner still reports the existing intermittent shutdown resource leaks.

Removed duplicated emission image data and generated-cache texture references from the newly converted run.tscn pause menu, reusing existing assets. Reduced scene from 9,916,548 to 35,936 bytes with node/connection sections unchanged. Resource guard passed; verbose compatibility runner exited 0 with 490 loads and zero failed assertions; existing intermittent shutdown diagnostics remain.

First architecture cleanup: externalized identical emission image data, shared ambient particle scene, removed first-party text-resource cache dependencies, authored battle presentation as a scene, added resource/overlay checks, and documented prioritized remaining work in ai/docs/godot-architecture-audit.md. Full-project cleanup remains open.

Reviewed Godot 4.7.2 and Talo 1.2.0 compatibility; migrated telemetry, repaired resource references and scene cleanup, updated CI/docs, and verified offline headless and D3D12 gameplay smoke tests. Remaining live-service/release validation and shutdown diagnostics are documented in ai/docs/godot-4.7.2-upgrade.md.
Fix end-of-battle audio stinger reliability and prevent repeated triggers.
Add impact profile kit (hit-stop, decals, scaled shakes) to damage handling for players and enemies.
Add punchy enemy death feedback (flash + smoke VFX, shake, optional death sounds) with double-trigger guard.
Reserve start tiles for special battle openings and prefer requested tile types during placement.
Retune enemy roster for v0.0.6.1 with gentler early threats, slower obelisk spawns, and toned-down elite/void defenses and payouts.
Refresh run and battle tutorial copy to teach obelisk objective, tile effects, and currencies for v0.0.6.1.
Boss health meter deferred until the boss redesign lands to avoid rework.
Add a reusable card cost selection popup with selectable card grid, hover details, and Events hooks for rituals/events.
Introduce Bulwark and Void Channeler enemies with unique actions and expand tier 1/2 battle pools to feature them.
Overhauled enemy intent display with consistent formatting, tooltips, and palette-based visual polish.
Make enemy AI pick attacks/blocks based on player distance, block, and kill potential instead of flat weights.
Add pulsing tile highlights with pooled sprites and a scan SFX when aiming cards so valid targets are clearly marked without wiping telegraphs.
Shortened discard/draw tweens and reshuffle trails so end-of-turn hand cleanup feels snappier.
Added a quick battle intro vignette/audio dip beat that plays as combat loads without delaying turn 1.
Seeded map event nodes and built a lightweight event room with gold/resource/HP tradeoffs.
Synced battle intro/outro presentation with vignette fades and audio swells around start/end of combat.
Added a map bounty board overlay that lists gold/resource rewards for currently reachable battles.
Started corrosion content expansion: added Corroded status plus Corroding Shot and Corrosion Wave cards to the Riftwalker draft pool.
Added a BattleState controller to own turn/shrink phases and route player/end/enemy loops through validated transitions.
Introduced CardResolver + declarative effect configs and migrated sample damage/block/move/gather cards off get_tree coupling.
Centralized card/movement targeting with a shared TargetSelector that caches valid cells and reuses validators for drag/aim flows.
